description: This file defines a React hook (`useProgressiveExpand`) and a non-React utility (`createProgressiveExpandController`) for managing progressive, batch-wise processing of work items with idle-time scheduling. It's used to expand nested trees or process large items without blocking the UI, providing progress feedback and cancellation.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive, batch-wise execution of work items with support for cancellation and progress updates.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that wraps around the above controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) while processing a set of items progressively.
